zh.title: 澳洲航空發表全新商務艙套房 導入A321XLR與波音787機隊
zh.summary: 澳洲航空發表新一代商務艙套房；引進平躺座椅與隱私滑門；首批2028年交機
body: 澳洲航空（Qantas）發表新一代商務艙產品，為即將引進的空中巴士 A321XLR 單走道客機機隊，以及旗下的波音 787-9 夢幻客機機隊，推出全新的全平躺商務艙套房。該航空公司表示，此項新座艙設計預計將於 2028 年起隨新機交付正式投入服務，為澳洲航空機隊更新計劃中的重要項目。
在空中巴士 A321XLR 部分，澳洲航空計畫在 16 架營運較長航線的該型客機上配備全新商務艙套房。該座艙採用 1-1 反向斜魚骨式配置，為澳洲航空首度在單走道客機上引進可完全平躺的座椅。每套套房均配有獨立滑門，並配備 19 吋機上娛樂螢幕、無線及 USB-C 充電設施、免費高速 Wi-Fi 網路，以及可存放手提電腦與個人物品的專用收納空間。
澳洲航空指出，A321XLR 航程可達 8,700 公里，比波音 737 客機增加超過 3,000 公里，未來將投入往返伯斯（Perth）的橫跨大陸航線，以及短程與中程國際航線。此外，針對波音 787-9 夢幻客機，澳洲航空也升級了現有的商務艙套房，每架客機維持 42 席商務艙，並首度在 Dreamliner 上引進滑門設計，床鋪長度提升至 80 吋，並擴大腳部空間。
澳洲航空集團執行長 Vanessa Hudson 表示，全新座艙反映了市場對高端旅行需求的轉變，目前其國際航線的高端艙等營收成長速度為經濟艙的兩倍。隨著次世代客機陸續加入，新機隊所配置的高端座位比例亦將高於其所替換的舊款機型，以進一步提升旅客的飛行體驗。

en.title: Qantas Unveils New Lie-Flat Business Suites for A321XLR and Boeing 787-9 Fleet
en.summary: Qantas unveils lie-flat business suites with privacy doors for its Airbus A321XLR and Boeing 787 fleets.
body: Qantas has unveiled its next-generation business class product, introducing new lie-flat suites for both its incoming Airbus A321XLR narrowbody fleet and its Boeing 787-9 Dreamliners. The announcement marks the first time the Australian carrier will offer lie-flat seats with privacy doors on a single-aisle aircraft, with the new cabins scheduled to begin arriving in 2028 as part of the airline's broader fleet renewal program.

The airline plans to install the new Business Suites on 16 Airbus A321XLR aircraft assigned to longer routes. Arranged in a 1-1 angled herringbone configuration, every business class passenger will have direct aisle access. Each suite features a seat that converts into a fully flat bed, a sliding privacy door, a 19-inch in-flight entertainment screen, wireless and USB-C charging capability, complimentary high-speed Wi-Fi, and dedicated personal storage designed for laptops and travel belongings.

With an operational range of up to 8,700 kilometers—more than 3,000 kilometers beyond that of the Boeing 737—the A321XLR will serve transcontinental flights to and from Perth, as well as short- and medium-haul international routes. Concurrently, Qantas unveiled an updated Business Suite for its Boeing 787-9 Dreamliners. The refreshed widebody cabin will retain 42 business suites per aircraft, introducing sliding privacy doors for the first time on a Qantas Dreamliner alongside 80-inch lie-flat beds featuring wider footwells developed through ergonomic testing.

Qantas Group CEO Vanessa Hudson noted that the investment reflects a structural shift in premium travel demand, with premium cabin revenue across the airline's international network growing at twice the rate of economy class revenue. The airline confirmed that its next-generation aircraft joining the fleet will carry a higher proportion of premium seating compared with the aircraft they are set to replace.

zh.title: Frontier Airlines 降低 Elite Diamond 門檻 25%
zh.summary: Frontier Airlines 降低 Elite Diamond 門檻 25% 增加里程
body: 根據 Simple Flying 於 2026 年 8 月 28 日發布的報導，Frontier Airlines 宣佈將 Elite Diamond 精英等級的門檻下調 25%。
同步調整包括提高里程累積速率，並為符合資格的會員提供頭等艙升級機會。
此外，航空公司計劃在 2027 年推出新的精英會員福利，進一步增強忠誠計畫吸引力。
報導指出這些變更旨在讓常旅客更快達成精英地位。
Simple Flying 為航空新聞網站，提供此項資訊。

en.title: Frontier Airlines cuts Elite Diamond requirements by 25% and adds First Class upgrades
en.summary: Frontier Airlines cuts Elite Diamond threshold 25%; boosts mileage earning; adds First Class upgrades
body: Simple Flying reported on 28 August 2026 that Frontier Airlines will lower the Elite Diamond qualification threshold by 25 percent.
The carrier also said it will increase mileage‑earning rates and grant First Class upgrade eligibility to qualifying members.
In addition, Frontier plans to introduce new elite benefits for 2027, further strengthening its loyalty programme.
The adjustments lower the Elite Diamond threshold and raise mileage earning rates.
The article was published on 28 August 2026 by the aviation news site Simple Flying.
The new elite benefits will roll out in 2027.
